locked_interpretation: WildBox camera geometry is available, but no independently verified metric-scale anchor exists for the three frozen sources. Therefore, no defensible meter-space conversion is performed. Existing normalized/image-space forecasting results remain valid and must be reported in their original coordinate representation.
prohibited_shortcuts: Do not insert an assumed drone altitude.
Do not infer meters from extrinsic translation magnitude alone.
Do not infer meters from focal length/intrinsics alone.
Do not call reconstructed camera coordinates world-ground-truth meters.
Do not convert normalized ADE/FDE to meters without external scale calibration.
future_resolution: A future metric-space extension would require source-specific measured altitude, known ground distance/GCPs, calibrated GSD/meters-per-pixel, or another independently validated physical-scale reference.
